rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Official Customer.io MCP server that enables AI assistants to interact with Customer.io's customer engagement platform through tools for workspace management, user profile inspection, segment generation, and SDK setup guidance. The implementation provides access to customer data, campaign analytics, and workspace configuration while maintaining security through OAuth authentication and workspace-specific permissions. Built for marketing teams and developers who want to programmatically analyze customer segments, troubleshoot campaign delivery, inspect user profiles, and integrate Customer.io functionality without manually navigating the platform interface.
